disagreements: GATE BLOCKED: Caller explicitly selected 2014 Vita エビコレ＋ (VLJM-35087/PCSG-00291); do not switch to 2009 PS2 or 2011 PSP. Written Japanese A includes route/event coordinates, exact choice fragments and ending conditions and acknowledges Vita; independent JP wiki supplies mechanics/partial routes, while 0xwas supplies a complete Ebi-edition all-epilogue schedule explicitly compatible with Vita. However, no single independently inspected Japanese A corpus yet establishes every exact in-game choice, map/time interaction, conversation/Attack success state, source-backed save and reload step for all main-six and hidden ending paths as a consistent executable run. The 0xwas chart abbreviates most choices to 1/2/3 and states wiki dependency; cannot fabricate Japanese text or treat it as independent literal Set B. English GameFAQs principally targets original PS2 and expressly leaves Vita differences uncertain; do not treat as exact-Vita E. Normal VN-Guide simpleJp requires literal menu text, whereas critical Amagami gameplay depends on selecting map coordinates, timetables and conversations; an appropriate repo-approved representation must be established without mislabelling invented prose as exact choice text. An independent edition-specific, full state-path reconciliation and verified portraits are required before route generation. No owner exception identified. Cover: directly viewed exact Vita box image fallback after VNDB direct access was blocked; portraits: official character catalog verified at https://www.amagami.info/chara.html, but individual original image URLs have not been validated, so blank rather than guessed paths. Note: main 6×(SUKI BEST/GOOD/BAD, NAKAYOSHI, SOEN), Sae's second SOEN, Kamizaki and Miya are all planned; this is not a finished guide.
